biotools.summary: MGDB (Molecular Genetics Dashboard) is a Python Dash/MySQL web application, distributed with docker-compose containerization, that performs variant-level quality control monitoring of clinical NGS sequencing runs, providing interactive visualization and assessment of variant data to detect inconsistencies and outliers.
